questions.topic: Row 89 - rear lamp and back-up switch plugs
questions.text: The factory plugs went with the missing rear wires. How do we get the mating plugs for R11 / R12, L1, H6 and B1?

options.label: Buy a used 90-93 Celica rear luggage-room harness (~$30-40 eBay; new Toyota 82181-20540 ~$80, check the VIN) plus Toyota 90980-11250 for B1 (~$14)
Dan photos the plugs on the car
Connect Claude in Chrome to search
